name: Domain-Adapted Dense Retriever
mechanism: Fine-tunes a dense retriever on audited target-domain positives and hard negatives or carefully validated synthetic relevance labels.
use_when: A strong zero-shot baseline fails stable domain slices
Representative positives and hard negatives can be governed
avoid_when: Chunking or parsing defects explain the misses
expected_effects: Higher recall on domain-specific query distributions
failure_modes: Catastrophic loss on general or multilingual slices
False negatives teach relevant documents as negatives
